#!/usr/bin/env python3
import requests
import base64

def main():
    # Get the data from the server, same as the app does
    response = requests.get("http://android-dropper.csaw.io:3003")
    encoded_data = response.text.strip()
    
    # Decode the data
    decoded_data = base64.b64decode(encoded_data)
    
    # Apply the obfuscation function from Dropped.java
    # obf(275, 306, 42)
    start = 275
    end = 306
    xor_key = 42
    
    flag = ""
    for i in range(start, end):
        flag += chr(decoded_data[i] ^ xor_key)
    
    print(f"Flag: {flag}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
